title: Serious Design Flaw Prevents this Reviewer From Purchasing More Than One Set
text: Serious Design Flaw Prevents this Reviewer From Purchasing More Than One Set. I do like this drawer divider. It's sleek and modular design is perfect, albeit a tad on the expensive side. However there is one design flaw that would make these a solid 5 star if it were corrected. The long pieces really need to be spring loaded, so that they fit the drawer tightly. This design has a gummy sticky piece on one end that secures to the back of the drawer, but the front doesn't so the front of the unit floats about unless every space has the spacer pieces installed. I have expensive wood drawers, and am quite reticent about "glueing" a piece in the drawer. What will the long term damage be to the drawer? I'm keeping the one set I purchased, and have it installed, but will probably not buy any more.
